p.src: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

p.src: 1  The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

en: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
u.src: 1  The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

p.src: 2  You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

en: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
u.src: 2  You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

p.src: 3  For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

en: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
u.src: 3  For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

p.src: 4  He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

en: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
u.src: 4  He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

p.src: 5  His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

en: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
u.src: 5  His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

p.src: 6  For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

en: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
u.src: 6  For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

p.src: 7  For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

en: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
u.src: 7  For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

p.src: 8  Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

en: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
u.src: 8  Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

p.src: 9  You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

en: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
u.src: 9  You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

p.src: 10  You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

en: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
u.src: 10  You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

p.src: 11  For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

en: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
u.src: 11  For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

p.src: 12  For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

en: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
u.src: 12  For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

p.src: 13  Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

en: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
u.src: 13  Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
